allow: Shell(for f in ~/.bash_history ~/.zsh_history ~/.local/share/fish/fish_history ~/.histfile; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "FOUND $f ($(wc -l < "$f") lines)"; done; echo "--- kubectl ---"; which kubectl || echo "no kubectl")

Shell(timeout 20 curl -s https://index.crates.io/config.json; echo; echo "--- versions ---"; for c in askama clap ratatui crossterm fuzzy-matcher serde_yaml; do v=$(timeout 20 curl -s "https://index.crates.io/$(echo $c | cut -c1-2)/$(echo $c | cut -c3-4)/$c" | tail -1 | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.loads(sys.stdin.read())['vers'])" 2>/dev/null || echo "ERR"); echo "$c = $v"; done)
